title: check/export: round-3 consistency fixes
description:
Settled by Claude on implementer recommendation, for Mark's review (round 3, 2026-10-22): (1) an automation grant concurrent with a commit removing its accountable's authority is VOID with a warning, not an error (consistency with decision C and DESIGN 'like any approval'); (2) removal from anchors.json gives the ex-anchor's keys valid-before = committer date of the removing commit (consistency with D5); (3) a demotion/replacement tier record that does not verify does not end the earlier tier; (4) a replacement across the automation line ends the old tier at the new signed record's date; (5) a bot switching its accountable needs a new tier record; (6) a record signed by a since-revoked key is reported void before any date check (no spurious 'dated outside validity' error); (7) retire-key/export: a signature in the same second as retirement must not verify (valid-before is inclusive in ssh-keygen: export retired-1s or retire at now+1s, pick one and test); (8) merges: a person-file version may be signed by a key current in ANY parent (keep), and a merge restoring a version signed by a concurrently retired/revoked key gets the D1 warning; (9) an older already-merged person-file version that no longer parses strictly does not reset continuity (continuity depends on keys only).
DECIDED (Mark, 2026-10-22) R1: a person-file change whose only previous-key signature is by a key revoked before that change (by ancestry) counts as unsigned and gets the D1 WARNING. DESIGN.md to say so.
DECIDED (Mark, 2026-10-22) R2: revoking the SUBJECT's own key does not void endorsements that named it; they carry over to the person's later keys, as DESIGN.md says. Only a revoked ENDORSER key voids an endorsement. Change check_registry (~lines 1756-1757) and its tests; vouching.md wording to match (re-confirmation after compromise is encouraged, not enforced).
DECIDED (Mark, 2026-10-22) R3: work around the OpenSSH 9.6 DST bug (git passes local time without zone; ssh-keygen reads it an hour off) by exporting valid-before = end time + 1 hour for retirements, removals and demotions, as one constant with a ponytail: comment naming the bug. No upstream report. This supersedes item (7)'s 'retired-1s' option: the same-second edge disappears inside the hour; keep a test that a signature made 2h after retirement fails. DESIGN.md: note the +1h and why it adds no risk (signers control timestamps).
acceptance_criteria: Each item has a test with real ssh-keygen signatures and real git history; DESIGN.md updated where it states the rule.
